Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Definition i := nat.

Inductive co : Set :=
 | co_id : co
 | co_trans (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_top : co
 | co_arr (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_pair (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_proj1 : co
 | co_proj2 : co
 | co_distArr : co
 | co_distRcd (l:i)
 | co_rcd (l:i) (c:co)
 | co_topArr : co
 | co_topRcd (l:i).

Inductive styp : Set :=
 | styp_top : styp
 | styp_nat : styp
 | styp_and (A:styp) (B:styp)
 | styp_arrow (A:styp) (B:styp)
 | styp_rcd (l:i) (A:styp)  .

Inductive st : Set :=
 | st_ty (A:styp)
 | st_la (l:i).

Definition ls : Set := list st.

Fixpoint calAnd (fs : ls) : co :=
  match fs with
  | nil => co_id
  | cons l fs' =>
    match l with
    | st_ty _ => (co_trans (co_arr co_id (calAnd fs')) co_distArr)
    | st_la l => (co_trans (co_rcd l (calAnd fs')) (co_distRcd l))
    end
  end.

Fixpoint calTop (fs : ls) : co :=
  match fs with
  | nil => co_top
  | cons l fs' =>
    match l with
    | st_ty _ =>  (co_trans (co_arr co_id (calTop fs')) (co_trans (co_arr co_top co_top) (co_trans co_topArr co_top)))
    | st_la l => (co_trans (co_rcd l (calTop fs')) (co_topRcd l))
    end
  end.

     sub A A co_id
 | S_trans : forall (A1 A3:styp) (c1 c2:co) (A2:styp),
     sub A2 A3 c1 ->
     sub A1 A2 c2 ->
     sub A1 A3 (co_trans c1 c2)
 | S_top : forall (A:styp),
     sub A styp_top co_top

 | S_topRcd : forall (l:i),

LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)

all: Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:
